notes: Fix: a minimized portal stays minimized until you bring it back. A check that every 5 seconds re-shows any open portal it cannot see treated a minimize as a fault and undid it. A portal Windows minimizes on its own as its screen goes away…
Fix: Omen opens on PCs set up before it had its own record. Open did nothing there, and Omen was missing from the Portals tab.
Fix: on PCs where an older version had switched the main portal to another theme (Fleet Command on one fleet machine), that portal is Omen again; the other theme keeps its own portal under Themes.
The Portals tab lists only portals. The retired classic Main Panel, which could not open but showed Open, Edit and Remove, is no longer listed.
scripts/placement-rig.js now also checks that a minimize stays for 60 seconds and that a minimize caused by a screen change is undone.
